# truenas_webshare (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS Webshare share by name. Requires TrueNAS 26.0 or later (see the truenas_webshare resource's schema description for the version-gate details).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Webshare share name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `dataset` (String) Dataset name component of path, or null if unresolved.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the share is available.
- `id` (Number) Numeric Webshare share ID.
- `is_home_base` (Boolean) Whether this share is the user home-directory base.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the share path is on a locked dataset, or null if unavailable.
- `path` (String) Local server path being shared.
- `relative_path` (String) Relative path component within the dataset, or null if unresolved.
